testcase.name: Given new currency and prefix and number format and negative number with grouping when reading a formatted will return the amount with new currency in prefix and number grouping

Given new currency and saving when reading the selected currency will return the saved currency
Given new currency and prefix and number format with grouping when reading a formatted will return the amount with new currency in prefix and number grouping
Given default currency when getting a default currency will return the same
Given new currency and prefix when reading a formatted will return the amount with new currency in prefix
Given new currency and prefix and number format and big negative number with grouping when reading a formatted will return the amount with new currency in prefix and number grouping
Given new currency and suffix and number format and big negative number with grouping when reading a formatted will return the amount with new currency in suffix and number grouping
Given default currency when reading a formatted will return the amount with default currency
Given new currency when reading a formatted will return the amount with new currency
